Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security review intake + SOC 2 evidence delivery timeline (ClarityHealth)

Hi Jennifer — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed MAP slice focused on the security review / SOC 2 evidence deliverable so we have clear owners and dates: 

Proposed milestones (security + SOC 2 package):
- Kickoff: architecture & data flow walkthrough (Redwood -> ClarityHealth) — target: 2027-03-18 — owner: Aditya (Redwood) / Tom (Clarity)
- Questionnaire returned (filled): 2027-03-24 — owner: ClarityHealth security (Jennifer)
- Evidence bundle delivery (logs, config snapshots, attestation docs): 2027-04-01 — owner: Redwood (we’ll package what we control)
- Internal review & confirmation: 2027-04-08 — owner: ClarityHealth risk committee
- Final signoff & contractual milestone: 2027-04-22 — owner: Both (target close)

Dependencies and notes:
- Clarity’s risk committee meets monthly; you mentioned next meeting on 2027-03-29 — we flagged that dependency in the timeline so approvals don’t slip.
- We can provide our SOC 2 Type II summary PDF and an indexed CSV of evidence to make ingestion easier.
- If you want, we can run an optional live walkthrough for the security team during the kickoff (30–45 minutes).

Attachments: I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary and a draft evidence index template for your review. I’ll ask Aditya to send the questionnaire template as well.

Please confirm that the dates look reasonable, or suggest alternate targets and I’ll update the MAP and send a new draft.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

--
Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
- evidence_index_clarity.csv (index template)

Subject: Re: MAP: security review intake + SOC 2 evidence delivery timeline (ClarityHealth)

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear breakdown. A few quick items from our side: 

1) We do need the SOC 2 Type II report (or a summary PDF) and a more detailed evidence index that maps each evidence artifact to the SOC control (if possible).
2) Our risk committee has a scheduled review on 2027-03-29. If evidence arrives by 2027-04-01, that gives us a tight but workable window for internal review.
3) Can your team confirm whether any of the requested evidence requires shared access to Redwoods’ internal consoles? We prefer uploads to our secure intake bucket versus live access unless necessary.

We’re open to the Mar 18 walkthrough for the security folks — Tom will join. Could you send the questionnaire ASAP so our team can start filling?

-Jennifer

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the quick reply. A couple clarifications and next steps from the security side (engineering):

- We are attaching the initial questionnaire (security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and an indexed evidence CSV (evidence_index_clarity.csv) that maps artifacts to control IDs. The CSV includes a "source" column so you can see which items we will produce and which are customer-side.
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf is attached (this is our Type II summary and scope page; full report is available under NDA).
- Regarding console access: we agree with your preference — we will push artifacts to a secure S3 bucket (pre-signed links) and provide checksums. We will not request interactive console sessions unless there is a blocker.
- Proposed walkthrough: 2027-03-18 10:00–10:45 PT — tech demo + Q&A. Agenda: architecture diagram, data residency controls, logging & retention, key management. Please confirm Tom and any additional security folks who will attend.

Timeline note: if we receive the completed questionnaire by 2027-03-24, we can complete the evidence bundle packaging by 2027-04-01. If the questionnaire is delayed, the evidence delivery date will slide accordingly.

Next immediate actions taken by Redwood:
- I attached the two files mentioned above and will create the secure bucket and share links after we confirm the preferred intake method.
- Marissa will own the MAP doc updates and will circulate a versioned PDF after this thread.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
